stem: Which sentence from the selection best expresses the author's enthusiasm during his observation of the penguins?

options.label: A
options.text: Across the crunchy surface, we could see hundreds of penguins in the distance, watching us as we watched them. (paragraph 10)

options.label: B
options.text: Penguins are extremely curious and not fearful of humans. (paragraph 11)

options.label: C
options.text: We began the two-mile hike over the ice to the penguin colony. (paragraph 14)

options.label: D
options.text: And I will never forget the penguin that, when I jokingly asked which way back to the helicopters, pointed a wing in the correct direction. (paragraph 18)
